recommendation: diagnosis_label: Outpatient prenatal medication guidance is appropriate. Stop the combination cold and flu product, prioritize hydration and rest, use acetaminophen alone for pain or fever if needed, and discuss any cough-specific single-ingredient medication with the obstetric team before further use.
follow_up: patient_demographics: Prompt obstetric follow-up is recommended. Seek same-day in-person care for inability to keep fluids down, worsening dizziness, fever above 38.0 C, shortness of breath, vaginal bleeding, pelvic pain, or new wheezing.
